list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Eight Gd(III) ions form a cube. Six sulfide ions cap its faces, twelve bridging phenylthiolates span its edges, and eight thf ligands complete the molecular cluster. The crystal contains two independent half-molecules differing mainly in phenyl-group orientation.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, Gd, PhSSPh and Hg were combined in thf and stirred for 1 day. Elemental sulfur was added; after 3 days the solution was filtered and the filtrate layered with hexane.

reagents.amount: 0.058 g (1.8 mmol; 0.75 equiv. relative to Gd)
reagents.name: Elemental sulfur

synthesis.time: 1 day before sulfur addition; 3 days afterward
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction under nitrogen; hexane layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered to remove a trace of black solid; the filtrate was layered with hexane to obtain colorless crystals. Crystals lose thf and become amorphous within hours of isolation.
synthesis.yield: 0.44–0.57 g and 42–57% across the Pr, Nd and Gd preparations; no Gd-specific yield stated

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as a member of the cubic Ln8S6(SPh)12(thf)8 cluster family, with a cube of eight lanthanide ions, six face-capping sulfides and twelve edge-spanning phenylthiolates. The Tb crystal is reported in monoclinic space group C2/c, a distinct phase from the triclinic Pr, Nd and Gd crystals.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The terbium complex is reported to crystallize from thf solution; no Tb-specific preparation quantities or work-up are given.
